title: The Non Negotiable FDE Skill
description:
What skills do you need to become a forward-deployed engineer? It starts with one non-negotiable foundation: real software engineering. That means strong Python, working with APIs (both consuming and building them), databases and SQL, notebooks, testing, debugging, and writing solid code. 

On top of that, system design and the ability to understand large-scale codebases, plus turning requirements into components, data flows, and trade-offs you can actually defend to clients and stakeholders. 


No shortcuts here, this is the base everything else builds on.

#techwithtim #aiengineer #techjobs

top_comments.author: @laravelcompany
top_comments.text:
Again, this guy giving developer advice… despite apparently having very little actual experience as a developer. You honestly couldn’t write satire this good.

At this point, mate, just rebrand the channel to “How to Sell People Bullshit and Call It Success.” At least then everyone knows what they’re signing up for.

The confidence is genuinely impressive. The résumé? Not so much.

And before anyone blindly buys into the guru act, maybe do five minutes of due diligence and look at the actual career history rather than the carefully manufactured internet persona.

The tech industry already has enough people pretending to be experts. We really don’t need another one selling the dream to people who are desperate to believe it.
